parsed_output.target_core_mechanism: A web/mobile app where users manually input pantry items and approximate expiration dates, receive meal suggestions based on that data, and log post‑cooking waste through simple questionnaires.
feasibility_notes: Manual entry of pantry items is technically simple and requires only basic UI components.
Generating meal suggestions from a user‑provided inventory can be done with rule‑based or simple recommendation algorithms without heavy AI.
Self‑reporting waste via questionnaires is low‑cost but relies on user honesty and recall.
Overall implementation cost is low, making rapid prototyping feasible.
reality_dependencies: Sufficient user willingness to regularly update pantry inventory and expiry dates
Accuracy and consistency of self‑reported waste data
Availability of a reliable recipe database that can be filtered by available ingredients and expiry constraints
Baseline measurement of household food waste for comparison
claims_needing_evidence: Providing tailored meal suggestions based on current pantry stock leads to measurable changes in cooking behavior
The intervention reduces overall household food waste compared to a control condition
Self‑reported waste questionnaires correlate well with actual waste quantities
Manual inventory entry does not create prohibitive user burden that negates benefits
potential_blockers: User fatigue or forgetfulness leading to outdated pantry data
Inaccurate or biased self‑reporting of waste
Low engagement with the questionnaire interface
Limited diversity of recipes causing suggestion fatigue
Difficulty obtaining a reliable baseline of waste for comparison
candidate_tests: Run a randomized controlled trial where one group uses the app (receiving suggestions and logging waste) and a control group does not; compare changes in self‑reported waste over a 4‑week period
Conduct a usability study measuring time and effort required for users to input pantry items and expiry dates, followed by a satisfaction survey
Validate the waste questionnaire by cross‑checking a subset of self‑reports with actual waste weighed in participants' kitchens
Perform an A/B test of two suggestion algorithms (simple rule‑based vs. optimized) to assess impact on cooking frequency and waste reduction
exploratory_candidate_tests: Prototype barcode scanning integration using open‑source computer‑vision models and evaluate accuracy of auto‑populated inventory versus manual entry
Develop a gamified version with point scoring for logging inventory and waste images; test its effect on user engagement and data completeness
Partner with a local grocery retailer to obtain anonymized purchase histories for a pilot group; assess feasibility of inferring pantry stock and expiry dates from purchase data
